---

sprawling 0.18.1 restores publication of the main crate on crates.io. RefRain bundles Latin fonts and uses device fonts for CJK text during offline reading. Release validation checks the actual size of every compressed Cargo archive before uploading.

Wire stays at 82, ledger format stays at 2, and configuration format stays at 1.
